source_snapshot.test_name_items: All HDD NVMe LED Check - Locate
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe RAID locate LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot
2. Select NVMe adapter and locate NVMe SSD
3. Check locate LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Undocumented raw IPMI bytes plus `lsblk` inventory.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Management result, device list and Locate LED observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; keeps physical confirmation but supplies raw bytes without platform target mapping or a stop operation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; requires stable identity, supported paired Locate operations, hot-plug safety and operator evidence.

original_test_intent: Across the project-defined NVMe HDD bay set, select each inserted SSD by stable adapter/slot identity, activate its Locate/UID indicator, and visually confirm the correct physical bay turns on and then off.
original_method: The operator performs safe insertion and watches the target bay; the agent resolves SSD serial to adapter/enclosure/slot and executes the documented paired Locate start/status/stop sequence for one approved bay at a time.
manual_activity: Physical insertion and confirmation of which chassis bay illuminates are core acceptance. Locate control is automatable, but it cannot establish the physical result; MANUAL ONLY applies.
required_inputs: Declared all-bay population and SSD serial list
Locate color/pattern and on/off truth table
Vendor-supported start/status/stop syntax and tool version
Hot-plug/ESD operator procedure, camera method and cleanup/recovery
safety_requirements: Do not hot-insert without platform approval or use boot/data/unknown SSDs.
Never assume controller/enclosure 0 or infer bay from `/dev/nvmeX` order.
Do not send undocumented IPMI raw bytes; validate exact OEM target semantics.
Activate only one verified target and include its stop operation in the unchanged plan.
No automatic adjacent-slot retry; stop on wrong/stuck indicator or hardware fault.
agent_execution_scope: Validate each SSD-to-bay map and capture baseline state.
Execute documented Locate start/status/stop on the single confirmed target.
Timestamp command, OS/controller/BMC events and correlate operator media.
Verify cleanup and compile per-bay Tool Results without physical/engineer claims.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform per-bay SSD insertion.
Visually confirm correct-bay Locate on/off for every in-scope target.
Resolve wrong/stuck indicators and decide PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unverified and incomplete: raw bytes lack OEM/bay mapping and stop semantics; `lsblk` cannot prove the physical Locate result.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use controller-vendor documented paired Locate operations with stable target identity; retain direct operator observation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-HDD NVMe scope, insertion, adapter selection, Locate inspection and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Drive a one-at-a-time serial/bay matrix through start/status/visual/stop phases and attach synchronized before/on/off media.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record controller/backplane/BMC firmware and utility/driver versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor Locate/UID command and platform slot/LED specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target proof and mandatory stop/cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Command acceptance cannot prove the intended physical bay or LED operated.

project_override_considerations: The project declares which bays constitute all-HDD coverage. Each claimed bay needs its own physical on/off evidence and exact command target.
expected_evidence: Population, serial/bay map, hot-plug approvals and LED truth table
Locate start/status/stop transcript with exact identity/timestamps
Per-bay on/off media, final health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Item, procedure and criterion consistently describe Locate LED behavior. Unspecified population and command are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is clear and becomes ready with the map, supported command and operator.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects undocumented raw control while retaining supplemental enumeration.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps stable identity/start-stop controls and applies MANUAL ONLY to physical acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes all-HDD coverage and cleanup independently auditable.

review_improvement: Prevents wrong-bay or lingering Locate state from being hidden by a successful management response.
independent_technical_reasoning: Locate is software-driven but accepted by observing the physical bay, and the source also requires physical insertion. These manual core steps determine the classification.
no_automatic_retry: After mismatch, issue only the approved stop once; do not try another bay, raw command or reseat automatically.
